units.source_text: 有关男人背着的姐姐的形象，后来只留下白色丧服的印象了。

en.t: As for the image of my sister being carried on the man's back, later only the impression of her white mourning clothes remained.

units.source_text: 我合上眼睛，企图努力在白色丧服上添头加足，

en.t: I closed my eyes and tried hard to add a head and feet to the white mourning clothes,

units.source_text: 可是总也不能如愿，而红土的山路、潇潇的细雨却印象鲜明地涌现出来。

en.t: but I could never make it come out as I wished; instead, the red clay mountain road and the softly falling fine rain rose up vividly in my mind.

units.source_text: 我内心焦灼万状，连背我姐姐的那个汉子的背影，也怎么都不肯在脑海里浮现。

en.t: I was frantic inside, and even the back of the man who had carried my sister would not appear in my mind no matter how I tried.

units.source_text: 这个在空中飘动的白色的东西，便是我对姐姐的全部记忆了。

en.t: This white thing drifting in the air was the whole of my memory of my sister.
